data.title: The Dawn of the Age of Amino Acid Sensors for the mTORC1 Pathway
data.authors: Wolfson RL; Sabatini DM et al.

evidence.label: Review — secondary literature, not a new result
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Review of the newly discovered amino-acid sensors feeding into mTORC1.
data.abstract_excerpt: The mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) is a master regulator of cell growth that responds to a diverse set of environmental inputs, including amino acids. Over the past 10 years, a number of proteins have been identified that help transmit amino acid availability to mTORC1. However, amino acid sensors for this pathway have only recently been discovered. Here, we review these recent advances and highlight the variety of unexplored questions that emerge from the identification of these sensors.

extracted_findings.effect: Reviews the recently discovered amino-acid sensors for the mTORC1 pathway
